ffmpeg-core.js and ffmpeg-core.wasm are @ffmpeg/core 0.12.10 from npm, unchanged.

They are FFmpeg n5.1.4 built with x264, x265, libvpx, LAME, libogg, libtheora, libopus,
libvorbis, zlib, libwebp, FreeType, FriBidi, HarfBuzz, libass and zimg, and FFmpeg is
configured with --enable-gpl, so the files are under the GNU General Public License,
version 2 or later (COPYING).

Source: the build scripts at
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/71aa99d37c02a7b4c435275ca9ef50e612f6efa1
(Dockerfile lists each library and its version) and FFmpeg n5.1.4 at
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/n5.1.4
